user.title: Cloudflare Abuse Monitor
user.description:
1. Open [Create a Cloudflare API token]({token_url}). The token needs exactly these permissions:
{permissions}
Check that all five rows are there; Cloudflare may leave one out, so add any missing row with **+ Add more**.
2. **Required:** the link starts with all accounts and all zones. Under **Account Resources** choose your account, and under **Zone Resources** choose **Specific zone** and your zone, so the token can touch nothing else.
3. Create the token and paste it below, with your AbuseIPDB API key.

Everything else is set up for you: the zone, the IP list `block_ips` and the two firewall rules (Block listed IPs, Skip to log visitors) are created when missing, never twice. A missing permission is named here.

list_select.title: Choose the IP list to block with
list_select.description: Cloudflare would not create a new IP list (your plan's list limit may be reached). Choose an existing IP list instead.

reconfigure.title: New Cloudflare API token
reconfigure.description:
Paste a new API token for {zone_name}. [Create one here]({token_url}) with these permissions (add any row that is missing):
{permissions}
Under Account Resources choose your account and under Zone Resources only this zone.
A setup that still uses the Global API Key moves to the token, and the email and Global API Key are removed.

reauth_confirm.title: Cloudflare needs a new API token

error.invalid_token: Cloudflare does not accept this API token (check that it was pasted whole, with no spaces or line breaks).
error.token_inactive: This API token is disabled or expired.
error.no_zone: The token cannot read any zone. Add Zone > Zone > Read for your zone.
error.wrong_zone: The token cannot read the zone this entry monitors. Choose that zone under Zone Resources.
error.missing_permissions: The token is missing: {missing}. Edit the token in Cloudflare, add them, and try again.
error.list_create_failed: Cloudflare would not create the IP list block_ips. Create it under Manage Account > Configurations > Lists, then try again.
error.rule_create_failed: Cloudflare would not add the firewall rules (the Free plan allows 5 custom rules). Create them by hand as described in the README, then try again.
error.invalid_abuseipdb_key: AbuseIPDB rejected this API key (check that it was pasted whole, with no spaces or line breaks).
error.connection_error: Could not reach Cloudflare or AbuseIPDB. Try again.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The new API token is saved.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API token is saved.
